newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two dead, six injured in S.Korea gas explosion.
newsitem.headline: Two dead, six injured in S.Korea gas explosion.

text.p: Two people were killed and six injured on Saturday when a three-storey building was destroyed by a gas explosion in Anyang City south of Seoul, police said.
Police said they had yet to determine the exact cause of the explosion which occurred at 12.15 a.m. The two victims died after being pulled from the half-collapsed building.
